direction: 18-clip stationary companion suite (celebrate, wave, clap, jump, finale, idle, idle_breathe, search, think, listen, encourage, shrug, flex, bow, march, wiggle, peekaboo, stretch) on UV-delimited decimated Bear_fixed_outfit (~14.4k tris) with seamless 2pi-periodic idle loops, parent-to-child Spine02 -> Spine01 -> Spine posing, world-axis arm clearance, and optional runtime/studio 3D props.

celebrate.description: Standing high overhead V-cheer with paws raised to ear height, shoulder lift, and joyful head nod.

wave.description: Friendly right-paw wave held high across a 1.5s plateau with 5 full frontal-plane waves, elbow pitched forward, and palm rotated forward (-Y).

clap.description: Five-beat forward chest clap held at constant chest height across the plateau so all 5 claps touch cleanly without vertical semi-raise phasing.

jump.description: Three-stage big jump: deep wind-up crouch with arms swept back, 21.5 cm mid-air star/tuck apex, and cushioned landing squat with arms lowering in a single continuous move.

finale.description: Four-cycle playful disco/boogie dance (2.8s) with hip-and-torso S-curve counter-groove, alternating high punch and low waist pump arms, and high-stepping legs.

idle.description: Seamless 2.8s (84-frame) 2pi-periodic caregiver sway, inhale, and warm double head-nod with continuous velocity across loop wrap-around.

idle_breathe.description: Seamless 3.6s (108-frame) 2pi-periodic calm breathing sway for low-distraction thinking and ambient idle.

search.description: Detective lookout scan with magnifying glass held up to the right eye and two left-to-right scanning sweeps.

think.description: Curious chin-tap gesture followed by an excited Aha! head perk and glowing pop-up lightbulb above the head.

listen.description: Cup-ear lean-in with right paw raised beside the right ear, head turned toward the child, and two attentive nods.

encourage.description: Encouraging double chest-pump with enthusiastic double head nod.

shrug.description: Playful open-palm shrug with lifted shoulders, palms supinated upward, and warm head tilt.

flex.description: Strong-bear superhero double-bicep pose with domino mask and two proud bicep pulses.

bow.description: Theatrical stage bow with left paw across the belly and right arm sweeping out holding a magician's top hat.

march.description: Six-step victory parade march with high alternating knees and right paw waving a pennant flag.

wiggle.description: Four-cycle fiesta hip shimmy shaking a pair of maracas in both hands.

peekaboo.description: Playful hide-and-peek covering the face with both paws before opening wide in surprise.

stretch.description: Big cozy overhead V-stretch with chest arch, gentle side sway, and relaxed return.
